initial.title: [v0.92.1][repository] Remove all tracked .adl paths and relocate required policy authority
initial.goal: Make .adl strictly local-only while preserving worktree-placement enforcement outside .adl.
initial.required_outcome: Zero tracked .adl paths, zero active repository dependencies on .adl authority, relocated worktree policy, and deterministic regression guards.
declared_scope: All active tracked references that require .adl authority
Worktree policy relocation and focused guards
authority_boundary: Historical evidence may mention .adl but cannot act as executable authority
operator_constraints: Do not publish logs, credentials, provider output, or private state
Use the new agent-logic repository and typed v2 lifecycle
initial.task_boundary: Remove tracked and authoritative repository dependence on .adl without redesigning worktree policy or moving .csdlc.
deliverables: Relocated worktree policy and updated consumers
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Exact pre-change tracked-path and active-reference inventories have one disposition per entry
AC-2: git ls-files .adl returns zero paths at the implementation head and in a fresh checkout
AC-3: Active source, build, test, documentation, CI, schema, manifest, policy, and fallback scans contain no authoritative .adl dependency
AC-4: One canonical policy outside .adl preserves allowed and rejected worktree behavior
AC-5: Git ignore and deterministic guards reject reintroduction
AC-6: No sensitive or local-only data is promoted
AC-7: Focused tests, fresh-checkout proof, diff hygiene, and exact-head review pass
initial.plan_summary: Inventory, relocate authority, remove tracked residue, add guards, and prove fresh-checkout behavior.

steps.action: Retain exact tracked-path and active-reference inventories with dispositions.
Relocate worktree policy and update every active consumer and focused test.
Remove every tracked .adl path and add deterministic reintroduction guards.
Run focused and fresh-checkout proof, then obtain exact-head review.

risks: Historical mentions may be confused with active dependencies
Removing local logs from the index must not promote them elsewhere
Fresh-checkout bind behavior may drift if policy resolution is incomplete
stop_conditions: Any active consumer still resolves .adl authority
A replacement would expose local or sensitive data
Fresh-checkout positive or negative policy proof fails

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove zero tracked paths and zero active authoritative dependencies.
Prove relocated policy resolution and allowed/rejected worktree behavior.

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed on any tracked .adl path, active .adl authority reference, sensitive promotion, policy drift, or failed fresh-checkout proof.
review_prompts: Can any active path still treat .adl as authority?
Does policy relocation preserve exact behavior?
Are historical mentions excluded without becoming fallback authority?
Was any sensitive local material promoted?
initial.review_scope: The complete tracked .adl migration, relocated policy consumers, guards, inventories, and focused proof.
